definitions.explanation: Severe lack of food, ranging from extreme hunger to widespread famine. Used in serious or formal contexts about food crises and deprivation.

examples.japanese: {飢餓|きが}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しむ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧。
⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飢餓|きが}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{直面|ちょくめん}している→直面する：15862_chokumensuru⟧。
examples.english: Many people around the world are facing starvation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{起|お}こされた→引き起こす：06165_hikiokosu⟧{飢餓|きが}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{何百万|なんびゃくまん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{失|うしな}われた→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: Millions of lives were lost to famine caused by war.

notes: A formal word used in news, academic, and humanitarian contexts. Common collocations include {飢餓|きが}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しむ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧ (to suffer from starvation), {飢餓|きが}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{直面|ちょくめん}する→直面する：15862_chokumensuru⟧ (to face famine), and {飢餓|きが}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (state of starvation). For everyday hunger, ⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{空|す}いた or ⟦{空腹|くうふく}→空腹：06532_kuufuku⟧ is used instead. ⟦{飢饉|ききん}→飢饉：00230_kikin⟧ (famine) refers specifically to a large-scale food crisis affecting a region.
